extension.summary: Google Drive as a Kodi WebDAV source
extension.description:
GDrive Bridge serves your Google Drive (My Drive, Shared with me and Shared drives) to Kodi as a read-only WebDAV source on this device. Add dav://127.0.0.1:8765/ as a video source and Kodi browses, scans and plays it like any network share, with seeking and subtitles.
Set it up from any phone, tablet or computer: open the add-on, scan the QR code and follow the steps. It signs in with your own Google Cloud client, so nothing passes through anyone else's server.
extension.news: v0.1.2: sign-in finishes by itself (Web application client + this project's relay page; your secret and sign-in never leave your Kodi device). Pick the client JSON file from your phone instead of pasting it. No more "not secure" pop-ups on the setup page's buttons, and it stays logged in when opened from another app. v0.1.1: archives and dot-files hidden (they froze Kodi). See changelog.txt.
